ready.none: Nothing. `moai show` shows what is waiting
overview.unread_snapshot: Could not read a sibling worktree's snapshot — {at}
overview.worktree_trouble_above: Trouble in sibling worktrees {n} — the lines above
overview.next: Next:  `moai ready` shows what to pick in each project
overview.uninit: before init — start with `{go}` and it shows up here
overview.missing_go: → register the new place if it moved, otherwise `{go}`
warn.no_epic: Issues with no epic {n} ({percent}% of open)
warn.wip_overload: Started at once {n} — finishing one at a time goes better
warn.stale_progress: Picked up and untouched over {d} days {n}
warn.stranded: Picked up with no worktree at work {n} — open a worktree again to carry on
warn.blocked_by_deferred: Held by something deferred {n} — undo the deferral or clear the block
warn.empty_epic: Empty epics {n} — planned and never filled
warn.dangling_epic: Rows naming something unusable as an epic {n}
warn.dangling_milestone: Rows naming something unusable as a milestone {n}
warn.dangling_blocked_by: Blocked by an issue that is not there {n}
warn.future_timestamp: Rows stamped over a day ahead {n} — a hand-edited time or a wrong clock
warn.user_config: Unread in the user config {n} — each one was said on stderr
warn.agents_stale: The AGENTS.md block differs — another binary wrote it, so this one may be the older (build again and look)
warn.agents_hand_edited: The AGENTS.md block was edited by hand — planting it again drops those edits
warn.gitignore_rules: .gitignore is missing {n} lines moai uses — sibling worktrees ride along with `git add -A`
warn.gitattributes_rules: .gitattributes is missing {n} lines moai uses — the journal conflicts on merge and line ends drift
warn.merge_driver_rotten: The planted merge driver does not run — merges fall back to the default one
warn.merge_driver_stale: The planted merge driver is an old one — if the recorded place goes, it drops their side with no markers
warn.merge_driver_alien: The planted merge driver is another tool of that name — it does not know this command, so merges fall back to the default one
warn.merge_driver_absent: This repository asks for the moai merge driver but this clone has not planted it — merges fall back to the default one
warn.unknown_field: Rows carrying unknown fields {n} — the file may come from a newer binary
warn.duplicate_id: Ids standing twice {n} — a merge scar, or a clash with an unreadable row
status.worktree_trouble: Trouble in sibling worktrees {n} — each one was said on stderr
status.next: Next:  `moai ready` picks what to take
ready.picked: Already picked up {n} — finishing those first goes better
ready.held_by_empty: Held by a group with no members {n} — fill the group or clear the block
opening.commands_here: Commands: `moai --help`   ·   how to work in this repo: AGENTS.md
warn.milestone_focus: A milestone is running — {n} outside it are left for later (p0 still gets picked)
ready.outside_held: {n} outside the running milestone are not listed — finish inside first (p0 still shows)
col.title: Title
detail.group_has_no_epic: (a group does not sit in an epic — status names it as an unusable reference)
detail.place_fresh: not showing yet — just picked up
detail.place_unknown: unknown — a sibling worktree could not be read
detail.place_lost: none — no worktree is at work on it
detail.duplicate_says: this id stands on {n} rows — the later one is opened (duplicate_id in moai status)
block.missing_says: no such issue, so it does not block
hook.lead: Work for this repo lives in moai. Do not use TodoWrite or a markdown TODO list.
hook.carried: You were already holding this before the compaction:
hook.still_held: You are still holding work. If it is really done, move it; if you are not doing it, defer it; if you will carry on, leave one line for the next session.
hook.waiting_hint: if it is waiting on a decision — left in the first column, {epic} stays open
hook.defer_closes: only to give up what {epic} set out to do — defer held work and {epic} closes with finished members alone
hook.defer_plain: if you are not doing it now
hook.review_open: Review issue {id} is still open. Attach what it produced and close it.
hook.warnings_grew: Warnings grew from {before} to {now}. Run `moai status` to see what grew.
refuse.link_both_ways: {id} cannot be blocked and unblocked at once
refuse.edit_nothing: You did not say what to edit. `moai edit --help` lists what can be edited.
refuse.init_no_prefix: Cannot make a prefix from the directory name. `moai init <prefix>`
detail.unread_column: the column is read from its members (the written column `{col}` is not read)
trouble.skipped: {at} — unreadable rows left out of the overlay {n}
trouble.no_git: Could not run git, so sibling worktrees were not found — {why}
trouble.stream: Reading the worktree listing was cut off — {why}
trouble.encoding: Could not read the worktree listing — {why}
warn.lang_table: `{key}` must be a `[{key}]` table — it is {is}
warn.lang_word: `{key}` must be a word — it is {is}
